recipe.text: Fresh 'Breach Siege' concept: enemies breach from 4 cardinal gates on a ring around a defended objective and march to center. Each wave spawns a config-driven count with escalating speed/health; wave clears when every spawned Humanoid has Died. Final wave clear => VICTORY. All lifecycle events (system online, player detected, wave start, per-spawn, breacher down, wave cleared, victory) print with the [Siege] tag for VERIFY. Enemies die only to player-level combat — no auto-kill/test hook wired.
